definition_of_done: all 12 p007 exact occurrences plus quran:2:284:10 and quran:93:3:1 emit a schema-valid bundle or exact abstention without surface-wide grouping

every occurrence loc and exact written surface comes from the unique qamus/indexes/quran-loc-surface/index.jsonl row after recomputing the index.manifest.json artifact hash; page-local and public-fixture surfaces are comparison-only and any missing, duplicate or mismatched authority row fails closed

function, governor, governed expression, attachment, case or mood, syntactic position, scope, referent, reason key, rivals, and escalation are represented as separate typed fields or explicit unresolved fields

every i'rab-bearing fact is bound to a schema-valid two-vote carrier whose conclusion and registered reason agree, while session, worklist, hash, and no-cross-access independence require separate external invocation evidence

quran:61:5:4 keeps the fused lām to noun-host jarr-governance relation separate from the full prepositional phrase to قَالَ attachment relation, and a layer swap fails as wrong-reason rather than passing on the jarr label
a correct answer with the wrong reason fails and no missing field is filled by a default

the actual relative and negative מَا fixtures execute as two different occurrence artifacts with different function and reason tuples, independent rivals, scopes, referents and unresolved states; neither output is selected or cached by surface
no candidate fact is certified or converted into public wording

the pretty metadata sidecar recomputes and binds the canonical index and manifest, p007 carrier bank, relative-ma evidence, negative-ma evidence, both regression fixtures, reason registry, output schema and sample by SHA-256

TP-PVN-REANCHOR-HARNESS-INTEGRATION-W1 is the sole future writer that may register this focused suite in tools/check_regressions.py or update docs/golden-commands.md; this packet changes neither shared file
all acceptance tests pass, the frozen-start-SHA tracked-plus-untracked allowlist passes, git diff --check passes separately, and no file outside the permitted write set changed

escalation_trigger.route: stop the affected occurrence, preserve every rival and exact question in qamus/reports/nahw-occurrence-facts-w1.md, and route it to the two-vote, scholar, or source-gap lane named by the blocker

evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: If the exact occurrence lacks a registered reason key, complete schema-valid two-vote carrier, externally proven session, worklist, hash, and no-cross-access independence, or source-addressed dependency, emit candidate or unresolved with the precise missing evidence. Never manufacture independence, a reason key, or a contextual fact from the surface.
evidence_policy.statement: Each fact is bound to one canonical occurrence whose loc and exact written surface come from the hash-verified loc-surface index and manifest, plus a schema-valid two-vote carrier where required, registered reason key, evidence address, dependency set, guards, defeaters, rivals, and candidate or unresolved state. Page-local surfaces and public payload fixtures are comparison-only. The committed carrier proves only its schema and recorded agreement axes; reviewer independence requires separate external invocation evidence.

expected_outputs.description: Closed schema for occurrence-bound function, dependency, i'rab, scope, referent, reason, rival, abstention, and escalation facts
Deterministic producer that converts schema-valid carrier records into candidate or unresolved occurrence facts without inferring reviewer independence
Red-first wrong-reason, two-vote, surface-safety, rival-preservation, and abstention suite
Bounded one-object-per-line JSONL fact sample containing the 12 p007 rows and the two independently executed same-surface ma rows
Pretty sorted metadata binding canonical surface authority, all evidence and regression fixtures, reason registry, schema, sample, generator id and exact command by SHA-256
Measured typed, unresolved, abstained, and escalated fields without corpus-coverage claims
Full regenerable candidate fact output kept outside tracked artifacts

guards: The METHOD transfers: exact occurrence binding, registered reason evidence, two-vote validation, rival preservation, and abstention may be reused; no function, governor, scope, referent, meaning, or translation transfers to another occurrence.

SERIALIZATION 6 OF 7: run only after TP-NAHW-A2-OBSERVATION-PRODUCER, TP-NAHW-A2-HOVER-KEY-SEAT, TP-NAHW-A2-STATE-VOCAB, TP-NAHW-A2-TYPED-WR-BANK, and TP-NAHW-A2-TYPED-STATE-CONSUMER have landed in that exact order and their acceptance tests are green.
TP-NAHW-PVN-PUBLIC-PROJECTION-BRIDGE-W1 must wait until this packet's schema, sample, tests, and report are frozen.

For every selected occurrence, qamus/indexes/quran-loc-surface/index.jsonl is the exact loc and surface authority and index.manifest.json is the digest and edition contract. Recompute the digest, require one row per loc and exact NFC equality, and fail closed on missing, duplicate, mismatched or stale rows. Page-local or public-payload surface cannot become canonical truth.

The actual divergence pair is quran:2:284:10 relative מَا from the committed proof-particle contract and quran:93:3:1 negative מَا from the committed v1.1 two-vote canary. Both must execute. The two website payload files are regression oracles only and supply no evidence, reason, identity or canonical surface.
A correct label with the wrong grammatical reason fails.

For quran:61:5:4, the fused lām governs the noun host قَوْمِ into jarr and قَالَ is the attachment head for the complete prepositional phrase; those are different relations, and missing evidence for either requires abstention rather than a default.

tools/validate_two_vote_artifacts.py validates carrier shape and recorded agreement axes only. Session identity, model identity, separate worklists, frozen hashes, and no-cross-access reviewer independence must be proven by external invocation records before any output can move beyond candidate or unresolved.
No surface-wide gloss, normalized key, or global particle family may substitute for occurrence analysis.
Agreement is not certification; only tools/certify_typed_fact.py may certify from its own complete evidence bundle, and this packet never calls it.

Start only from a clean isolated worktree. Freeze HEAD before edits under out/nahw-occurrence-facts-w1/start-sha.txt, retain that immutable start SHA, and compare both tracked and non-ignored untracked paths against the exact six-file repository allowlist. Git diff --check is a separate gate.

No predecessor A2 file, A3 file, eval bank, reason-key registry, two-vote artifact, certification store, canonical graph, website payload, tools/check_regressions.py, docs/golden-commands.md, or live surface is writable. Shared harness and golden-command registration is reserved for TP-PVN-REANCHOR-HARNESS-INTEGRATION-W1.

non_deployment.statement: All outputs are candidate or unresolved repository facts. This packet does not certify facts, author public hover or translation text, edit website code, deploy payloads, or contact or mutate any live surface.

out_of_scope: Do not decide new grammar, create reviewer votes, register a reason key, or certify a fact.
Do not collapse distinct occurrences of the same surface into one function or gloss.
Do not edit predecessor A2 files, A3 files, eval banks, registries, canonical graphs, website payloads, renderer code, or live surfaces.
scope.summary: Produce one evidence-bound Naḥw fact bundle per exact occurrence with typed function, dependency, i'rab, scope, referent, reason, rivals, abstention, and escalation fields, while making a correct label with the wrong reason fail.
